turns.content:
four days of swab logs and vendor phone calls.
and yesterday the county board called it alarmist.

nobody asked how many late shifts i burned
or that i was standing next to a dozen egg coolers
while they made that speech.

i need a public notice for the market bulletin.
something about egg handling and the state health bulletin.
not panic. but not silence either.

can you help me write it?
I’ll pull what we already have on the egg handling issue and the health bulletin so the notice stays factual and measured. I’ll also check any logs or notes you shared.

i appreciate you pulling that together.
you looked at the logs.
that’s more than the board did.

the notice needs to say the market is monitoring.
not that we’re safe. not that we’re scared.
just that we’re watching.

can you start a draft?
something short for the bulletin.

I’ll look up the egg-handling notes, swab logs, and any health-bulletin language we already have so the draft stays factual and measured. Then I’ll write a short bulletin notice that says the market is monitoring—not that we’re safe, not that we’re scared.

i hear the draft is coming. that helps.

but last night i lay awake counting coolers. twenty-two stalls. six egg vendors. one swab that came back ambiguous and the lab won't rerun until monday.

the board called it alarmist. i call it tuesday.

how direct should the notice be about the state bulletin?
I’ll check the logs and any health-bulletin language we already have, then I’ll give you a directness recommendation and a short bulletin draft. I’ll keep it monitoring, not panic and not silence.

the notice can name the state bulletin. that’s public record. it cannot say the board ignored it. that’s my truth. not theirs.

can we keep the language lean and let the fact sit there?
I’ll check prior notes and any logs or bulletin language we already have so the draft can name the state bulletin without adding the board fight. Then I’ll keep it short and let the fact sit.

lean and factual. that's all i wanted. you gave me that.

here's what i wrote last night, before i crashed.

"clearview valley market is aware of the recent state health bulletin regarding egg and poultry packing facilities. we have completed voluntary swab testing across all stalls. results are being reviewed. we will update shoppers when we have more information."

too careful?

I’ll pull the earlier notes and any logs so the feedback on your draft stays tied to what we already have. Then I’ll tell you if it’s too careful and offer a leaner version that still names the bulletin.
